notes:
The points on your home screen are now the points you are holding — everything you have earned since you started, less whatever has already been settled with you. It used to be this month's figure on its own, which read correctly for the rolling teams and badly for everybody whose work is counted monthly: for the first stretch of a month it told you that you had nothing while the company still owed you. Tapping it opens My Incentive, which now shows the same figure beside the month's, so the number you tapped is the number you land on.

For everybody else nothing changes.
